name: arc-fill-between-horizontal-markers
description: Use when ARC grids show repeated same-color marker pairs in rows; fill horizontal gaps with color 2.
---

# Fill between horizontal markers

For this ARC task family, scan each row independently. Keep the nonzero marker cells unchanged. Whenever two same-color marker cells bound a horizontal gap in a row, fill every zero cell strictly between them with color 2. If a row has multiple marker pairs, fill each gap (in the examples, pair consecutive markers from left to right). Leave cells outside gaps and rows without a complete pair unchanged. Marker color varies by instance; the inserted fill color is 2.

## Evidence / validation

- Demo with color 3: row marker pairs at columns 2 and 4, 1 and 5, 0 and 6 yielded color-2 fills in the intervening cells.
- Demo with color 4: pair at columns 1 and 5 yielded fills at columns 2–4.
- Test with color 6: rows with marker pairs at (2,8), (1,3) and (3,7), and (0,4) and (4,6) were filled between their markers; the row with only one marker was unchanged. This output was confirmed correct.
